acceleration.description: Pixels per second squared. 0 means the entity reaches its top speed instantly.

deceleration.description: Pixels per second squared. 0 means the entity reaches its top speed instantly.

airControl.description: How much of the acceleration still applies while in the air, from 0 to 1.

fallGravityMultiplier.description: Falling is faster than rising by this factor. It is the single biggest reason a jump feels solid rather than floaty.

jumpHeight.description: How high a jump reaches, in pixels.

jumpCount.description: How many jumps are available before touching the ground again. 2 is a double jump.

variableJumpHeight.description: Releasing the jump button early cuts the jump short.

coyoteTime.description: A jump still works for this long after walking off a ledge.

jumpBufferTime.description: A jump pressed this long before landing still fires on landing.
